inputValidation.relation: Post-run byte comparison to the named committed product tree and exact upstream gitlink. Receipts bind input bytes and do not embed a product commit field.
inputValidation.preparedMapping: All 26 captured client-projection inputs are byte-identical to corresponding raw pinned upstream blobs; no overlay or rewrite is inferred.

scheduler.scope: Exhaustive reachable-state safety checking of the finite abstraction.
scheduler.stepsFieldMeaning: Generic runner metadata; installed TLC does not apply max-steps as an exploration-depth bound.

domains.MountedUpdateAdmission: Two activation IDs and two bridge IDs.
domains.NativeUpdateStaging: Two offers, three bridge IDs and four abstract APK bytes. PackageInstaller.commit is outside this model.
domains.CanonicalCalendarDraft: Two owners, binding leases up to six and fixed draft titles.

coverage.meaning: Source allocation and drift admission, not exhaustive implementation refinement.

ast.meaning: Syntactic candidate extraction, not proof of complete mutable-field or transition coverage.

repairTargets.scope: Pre-PR857-main-integration repair verification; not final full verification.
repairTargets.namedActionScope: Current SQL traces select currentSqlWrite wrapper actions; they do not establish refinement of historical M::Step/Spec or exhaustive current global-relation refinement.

limitations: No temporal liveness or unconditional eventual installation was proved.
Progress requires foreground timer delivery and settling native/network/OS operations.
Physical installation, release/signing qualification, real integrations and user acceptance are separate.

finalFullVerification.scope: Separate full repository run; does not extend the checker bounds or prove temporal progress.
